summary: Exported components: 2 (MainActivity, ProfileInstallReceiver). Permissions include INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, custom DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION. App allows cleartext traffic, data backup, legacy external storage.
top_risks: Unprotected exported activity enabling arbitrary launch
Exported receiver accepting intents from other apps
Backup data potentially leaking private notes
MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE privilege enabling system file manipulation
abuse_hypotheses: Craft intent to start MainActivity to bypass authentication flow
Configure broadcasts to trigger ProfileInstallReceiver actions
Sniff network traffic due to cleartext vulnerability
Use backup mechanism to exfiltrate notes via cloud restore
Exploit MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE to read/write sensitive data on device
recommended_next_steps: Restrict MainActivity with a protecting permission or set exported="false"
Remove or secure ProfileInstallReceiver (add necessary permission or disable)
Disallow cleartext traffic through networkSecurityConfig or enable HTTPS only
Disable allowBackup or use encrypted backups
Reevaluate need for MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE; consider scoped storage APIs
